subject: Order Form / Pricing safeguards — clarifying caps, floors, and anchoring
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procure@nimbushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Sutter <mark.sutter@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nimbus draft redline — Exhibit A (pricing) and Order Form

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is our procurement redline on the Order Form and Exhibit A — we focused on the pricing schedule, the minimum monthly commitment language, and the proposed cap/floor mechanism. A few asks in the document:

- We'd like an explicit annual cap on per-month overage increases, tied to CPI (not to exceed 6% per annum).
- The floor for discounted rates needs to be tied to a 12-month minimum spend commitment (we propose a 50% floor for months below the committed volume).
- Please confirm whether the fallback pricing (if a model variant is used) preserves the same discount tiers.

Attachment: Nimbus_Redline_v3.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

Can you review and flag any non-starters? We need legal sign-off by 2/20 to hit our purchase order timeline.

Best,
Ava Thompson
Head of Procurement
Nimbus Health
[Attachment: Nimbus_Redline_v3.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procure@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus draft redline — Exhibit A (pricing) and Order Form

Ava — thanks for the redline and clear priorities. Quick read-through from commercial POV below; Marissa and legal should comment on contract language.

- Annual cap on per-month overage increases: we can accept a capped indexation clause (CPI-based, max 6%) but need to carve out changes in cloud hardware costs for dedicated deployments.
- Floor tied to 12-month minimum: we understand the ask. Our standard approach is to true-up on a quarterly basis with a pro-rated floor for partial months; we can map this into Exhibit A if you accept a one-time annual reconciliation.
- Fallback pricing across model variants: yes — pricing tiers are preserved for compatible model variants, but we need to enumerate which model substitutions are considered "compatible" in Exhibit B.

I'll loop in Rishi for commercial approval and Marissa for legal redline guidance. If acceptable, we can produce a counter-redline by EOD 2/12.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment reference: OrderForm_Draft.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus draft redline — Exhibit A (pricing) and Order Form

Folks — reviewing the attached. A few legal points we should negotiate before committing:

1) "Floor" definition — we need to avoid a fixed-percentage floor that applies retroactively for months when Nimbus is below forecast. Counter proposal: a tiered true-up where months below committed volume are billed at the next higher tier's rate for the shortfall, and an annual reconciliation limits total retroactive exposure to 25% of the year-over-year spend.

2) "Cap" on price increases — acceptable with CPI max 6%, but include language excluding external pass-throughs (third-party model licensing or cloud region premium).

3) Model substitution — define compatible substitutions by architecture/latency class rather than exact model names; provide a list in Exhibit B that we can update.

4) Audit and usage attribution — request to limit their audit rights to quarterly reports and require pre-notice for any on-site audits.

I will draft redline suggestions and attach them to a counter by 2/12. If Rishi confirms commercial flexibility on the floor, we can inform the customer we will accept a reconciled floor (subject to caps above).

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus draft redline — Exhibit A (pricing) and Order Form

Thanks Marissa — I'm comfortable with the tiered true-up (limits our downside) and the CPI cap with pass-through carve-outs. Commercial ask from my side: we keep the effective discount bands intact and offer a modest concession on the floor (45% floor instead of 50%) if Nimbus agrees to a 12-month committed ARR and an annual reconciled true-up.

Soojin — please include that concession in the counter and call out the DocuSign timeline; they want legal sign-off by 2/20. I'll prepare the approval note once Marissa posts the redline.

Rishi
Director, Sales — Enterprise

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mark Sutter <mark.sutter@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus draft redline — Exhibit A (pricing) and Order Form

Ava — appreciate the patience. Attached is our counter-redline (high level summary below; full redline attached):

- We can accept an annual cap on price increases pegged to CPI with a 6% ceiling; this will exclude third-party pass-throughs (cloud region surcharges, licensed model fees) — see Section 2.1c.
- For months below committed volume we propose a tiered true-up mechanism with an annual reconciliation that limits retroactive exposure to 25% of the prior year spend. As commercial concession, we are willing to set the operational floor at 45% (instead of your 50%) contingent on a 12-month committed ARR and listed Exhibit B compatibility taxonomy.
- Model substitution: we added Exhibit B language to define compatibility by latency/throughput class and included a mechanism to update the list with 30 days' notice.

Next steps: please review the attached PDF redline and confirm if your legal team can accept the 45% floor and the annual reconciliation. If yes, we'll generate a clean Order Form and send a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Attachment: Redwood_Counter_Redline_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Thanks,
Soojin
[Attachment: Redwood_Counter_Redline_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB); OrderForm_Draft.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)]

From: Ava Thompson <ava@nimbushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Sutter <mark.sutter@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus draft redline — Exhibit A (pricing) and Order Form

Soojin — thanks for the quick turnaround and for being flexible. Nimbus legal has reviewed and we can accept the CPI cap (max 6%) and the exclusion carve-outs. On the floor: we will accept the 45% operational floor only if the following are included in the Order Form:

- A quarterly reporting schedule with monthly usage detail to support the annual reconciliation;
- A clause that any model substitution which increases per-token cost by >10% triggers a price review prior to substitution;
- Confirmation that the annual reconciliation will include a single true-up invoice (no retroactive rate changes mid-year).

If you can confirm those three items, we are ready for the DocuSign envelope. Please send the final Order Form and I will route for our CFO signature.

Regards,
Ava Thompson
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health
[Next step: awaiting final Order Form DocuSign link]
